rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing someone whose behaviour or words are hypocritical.

example.english: He says he supports environmental protection, but he drives a large-engine car all the time; he’s really hypocritical.
example.traditional: 佢表面話支持環保，自己就成日揸大排量車，真係好虛偽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 biu2 min6 waa6 zi1 ci4 waan4 bou2 zi6 gei2 zau6 seng4 jat6 zaa1 daai6 paai4 loeng6 ce1 zan1 hai6 hou2 heoi1 ngai6

rows.note: Use this when someone pretends to be kind, moral, or righteous while acting otherwise.

example.english: You don’t need to be hypocritical in front of people and bad-mouth them behind their backs.
example.traditional: 你唔使喺人哋面前假仁假義，背後又講人壞話。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 gaa2 jan4 gaa2 ji6 bui3 hau6 jau6 gong2 jan4 waai6 waa2

rows.note: Use this more formal term in writing or when explicitly describing hypocrisy.

example.english: This article calls it hypocritical when society masks self-interest in the name of morality.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章批評社會上以道德之名掩飾利益嘅偽善。
